flow_summary: The interviewer successfully completed the intake but struggled significantly with the patient's confusion. While the interviewer was patient and persistent in re-asking questions, they frequently relied on repetitive, robotic phrasing and struggled to adapt to the patient's need for simpler, more direct communication, leading to a tedious and mechanical interaction.

issues.evidence: The interviewer repeatedly used the phrase 'आगे बढ़ने से पहले, क्या आप ऊपर दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दे सकते हैं?' even when the patient had just answered or was clearly struggling with the format, making the interaction feel overly scripted.

When the patient expressed confusion about the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 scales, the interviewer repeatedly re-read the full list of options rather than simplifying the explanation or guiding the patient more effectively, causing the patient to loop in their confusion.

In turn 13 of the psychiatric history, the interviewer bundled two distinct questions: '2009 में हुए ओवरडोज़ के बारे में संक्षेप में बताइए। क्या अभी या तुरंत कोई सुरक्षा संबंधी चिंता है—क्या आप इस समय सुरक्षित हैं?' which is poor practice when dealing with a confused patient.
